title: Secret Billionaire: The Chuck Feeney Story
summary: An RTE documentary on Chuck Feeney, the Atlantic Philanthropies founder who secretly gave away his fortune. It covers his Giving While Living approach and his gifts to Irish education.
why: Recommended in threads on Feeney as a decent, thorough account of his anonymous giving.

quote.text: I watched an excellent documentary on this man a few years back[0].
